svg.aria-label: How the video-to-spec skill works: a screen recording is split into deduplicated frames and a transcript, merged into a timeline, mined for tasks, and written out as a numbered spec folder.
svg.text: Any walkthrough ffmpeg can read – .mp4, .mov, .webm. Captions
(.srt / .vtt) are picked up automatically whenever they exist.
One frame per second, then a dedup pass
over perceptual hashes – cursor drift out,
transcribes it – locally via mlx-whisper, or
through the OpenAI API when you opt in.
Every spoken sentence is matched to the screen it was said on, so
the screenshot settles it whenever the words alone are ambiguous.
Four signals read off the timeline, each cross-checked against its frame:
Numbered user stories with the screenshots embedded inline – one
self-contained, reviewable file per task, ready to delegate to AI agents.
